settings.heading: How can we help?
settings.text: Answers to the questions we hear most. For anything about a product, warranty or return, our help desk covers every brand.

settings.a: The discount depends on how many different brands are in your order: 5% for two brands, 10% for three and 15% for four or more. It's applied at checkout.

settings.q: Are the prices the same as the brand websites?
settings.a: Yes. Single products are the same price here as on each brand's own Australian site. The mixed-brand saving only happens here.
Orders ship from the Coolkidz warehouse. Delivery options and costs are shown at checkout.

settings.q: How do returns and refunds work?
settings.a: See our refund policy. For a faulty product, open a ticket at help.coolkidz.com.au and our team will sort it out.

settings.q: Do products come with an Australian warranty?
settings.a: Yes. Everything is official Australian stock, and warranty claims for every brand go through help.coolkidz.com.au.

settings.q: How does the gift registry work?
settings.a: Create a registry, add products from any of our brands, and share one link. Bought gifts come off the list on their own. Start a registry.

settings.q: Is there a product recall I should know about?
settings.a: Current notices are on our refunds and recalls page.
